description: Pfam PF29920 membership splits the ICY1 and ATG41 ohnolog branches despite the shared invariant motif; ICY1-ATG41 paralogy significance
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests

pf = json.load(open("out/pf29920.json"))
members=set(pf["members"]); motif=pf["motif_hits"]
# classify motif-positive proteins by length branch (ICY1 branch ~123-127, ATG41 branch ~133-145)
q=" OR ".join(f"accession:{a}" for a in motif)
j=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
               params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,id,protein_name,organism_name,length","format":"json","size":"60"},
               timeout=120).json()
rows=[]
for e in j["results"]:
    a=e["primaryAccession"]
    nm=(e.get("proteinDescription",{}).get("recommendedName",{}).get("fullName",{}).get("value")
        or (e.get("proteinDescription",{}).get("submissionNames") or [{}])[0].get("fullName",{}).get("value") or "")
    rows.append(dict(acc=a, entry=e["uniProtkbId"], length=e["sequence"]["length"],
                     organism=e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName"), name=nm,
                     in_PF29920=a in members))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["in_PF29920","length"])
T.to_csv("ICY1_motif_and_PF29920_membership.csv", index=False)
print(T.to_string(index=False))
print("\nLength by PF29920 membership:")
print(T.groupby("in_PF29920").length.describe()[["count","min","50%","max"]])
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
a=T.length[T.in_PF29920]; b=T.length[~T.in_PF29920]
u,p=mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater")
print("Mann-Whitney (members longer than non-members): U=%.0f p=%.2e" % (u,p))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.8), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1,1.25]})
ax=axes[0]
for mem,col,lab in [(True,"#1b7837","in Pfam PF29920 (ATG41)"),(False,"#b2182b","excluded from PF29920")]:
    s=T[T.in_PF29920==mem]
    ax.scatter(s.length, np.random.RandomState(1 if mem else 2).uniform(-0.2,0.2,len(s))+(1 if mem else 0),
               s=55, color=col, alpha=0.8, label=lab)
ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["excluded\n(ICY1 branch)","included\n(ATG41 branch)"], fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("protein length (aa)")
ax.scatter([127],[0], s=160, facecolor="none", edgecolor="black", lw=2, zorder=5)
ax.annotate("ICY1 (Q04329)", (127,0), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(6,16), fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("All 28 UniProtKB proteins carrying the invariant motif AQQNYRLWLSS\n"
             "Pfam PF29920 captures only the longer ATG41 ohnolog branch (p = 1.1e-06)", fontsize=9.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right")

ax=axes[1]
prof=pd.read_csv("ICY1_conservation_profile.csv")
sw=json.load(open("out/icy1_atg41_sw.json"))
bars=[("ICY1 vs ATG41\nSmith-Waterman", sw["score"]), ("shuffled ATG41\n(mean of 50)", sw["null_mean"]),
      ("shuffled ATG41\n(max of 50)", sw["null_max"])]
ax.bar(range(3),[b[1] for b in bars], color=["#1b7837","#999999","#cccccc"])
ax.errorbar([1],[sw["null_mean"]], yerr=[sw["null_sd"]], color="black", capsize=5, fmt="none")
ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels([b[0] for b in bars], fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score (BLOSUM62, -11/-1)")
ax.set_title("ICY1 and ATG41 are genuine paralogs\n29.9% identity over 137 aligned positions, z = 17.2 vs shuffled null", fontsize=9.5)
for i,(l,v) in enumerate(bars): ax.text(i, v+3, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
